# Native response-file contracts

Generated by tests/support/c312_native_storage_faults.py with an explicitly
configured platform LittleFS fixture. It executes30 Rust Core APDU contracts
through real native storage services and independently verifies recoveries.
Faults are injected at the file-read boundary before service validation.
This is separate from paired USB/NFC and equal-byte totals, and establishes
neither physical flash behavior nor the MCU-specific Rust adapter.
